MHLW Model SDS for acetone, Section 6 pinpoint statements
Otsu4 exam relevance, semantic distinctness, answer uniqueness and no-filler policy

decisions.rationale: The SDS expressly requires ventilation before entry into an enclosed place. It is a distinct leak-entry condition, not the canonical pre-repair ventilation or general leak-isolation decision.
The SDS expressly requires preventing entry into drains, sewers, basements, or enclosed places. This is a separate containment decision with one unambiguous correct choice.
Use of a clean antistatic tool for collecting absorbed small spills is expressly stated and is operationally distinct from canonical preventive grounding/static-control questions.
The safety condition on stopping a leak is directly stated in the SDS and makes a useful intervention-versus-personal-safety boundary without a canonical semantic duplicate.

Vapor-suppression foam for reducing evaporation concentration is an explicit leak-vapor-control instruction. Its leak-response purpose is distinct from canonical fire-extinguishing foam mechanism recall.

collision_review.note: All five items are independently source-confirmed Section 6 leak-response decisions. They remain semantically distinct from existing isolation, static-prevention, repair-preparation, and fire-extinguishment questions.
